$schema.description: Optional link to this schema, for editor completion. Ignored by Wallweaver.

id.description:
Package id: lowercase letters, digits, dots and dashes, 3 to 64 characters.
A `creator.name` style id is recommended, for example `mira.aurora-loom`.

name.description: Display name shown in the gallery and library.

version.description: Semantic version of the package, for example `1.2.0`.

type.description: What kind of package this is.

entry.description: Path of the file Wallweaver loads first, relative to the package root.

license.description:
SPDX license expression, for example `MIT` or `CC-BY-4.0`.
Use `LicenseRef-<name>` for a custom license.

description.description: One or two sentences describing the wallpaper.

tags.description: Up to 10 lowercase tags such as `space` or `audio-reactive`.

preview.description: Thumbnail image (png, jpg or webp), relative to the package root.

properties.description:
User-adjustable settings, rendered by the app and delivered to the
wallpaper through `wallweaver.onProperties()`. Order is kept.

permissions.description: What the package asks to use. Anything not listed is denied.

slideshow.description: Images and timing for a `slideshow` package. Not allowed on other types.

render.description:
How the native renderer should draw the wallpaper. Every field is
optional and the defaults suit most wallpapers.

title: Wallweaver wallpaper.json
description: Manifest for a Wallweaver wallpaper or theme package (schema v1).

oneOf.description: A still image (png, jpg or webp).
Several still images shown in turn. List them in `slideshow.images`.
An animated image: GIF, animated WebP or APNG.

A fragment shader: WGSL, or GLSL written the Shadertoy way
(`mainImage(out vec4, in vec2)` with `iTime`, `iResolution`, `iMouse`).
A looping video file (mp4 or webm).

HTML, CSS and JavaScript (including WebGL and WebGPU). The only type
that runs in a web view.
Color tokens, fonts and optional wallpaper bindings.

WallpaperType.description:
Package type. Everything except `web` is drawn by Wallweaver's native
renderer, so no browser engine is loaded for it.

url.description: Optional https link to the author's page.

label.description: Label shown next to the control.

default.description: Starting value. Must be between `min` and `max`.

step.description: Step between values. Defaults to a smooth slider.

oneOf.description: A number picked on a slider.

label.description: Label shown next to the control.
Label shown next to the control.
Label shown next to the control.

default.description: The `value` of the option selected at first.

oneOf.description: One choice from a fixed list.

ComboOption.description: One entry in a combo property.

audio.description:
Audio levels of what is playing (64 frequency bars). Never the
microphone and never raw audio.

system.stats.description: System usage figures the package wants, refreshed once a second.

weather.description: City-level weather supplied by Wallweaver's weather plugin.

calendar.description: Upcoming calendar events from a calendar the user picks.

network.description:
Origins the package may contact directly, such as
`https://api.open-meteo.com`. https and wss only, no paths, no
wildcards, no local network addresses. At most 8.

input.mouse.description: Pointer position while the desktop is visible. No clicks or keys.

script.eval.description:
Allow `eval()` and `new Function()`. Avoid it if you can; the consent
screen marks it as a risk.

Permissions.description:
Permissions a package asks for. Everything defaults to denied, and the
user still has to approve each one on the consent screen.

oneOf.description: Network throughput in bytes per second (no addresses, no content).

StatKind.description: A system statistic a package can ask for.

images.description:
Image paths in display order. `entry` must be one of them; it is shown
first and used as the still snapshot.

interval.description: Seconds each image stays up, 5 to 86400. Defaults to 300.

shuffle.description: Show the images in random order.

Slideshow.description: Images and timing for a slideshow.

fit.description: How an image that doesn't match the screen's shape is fitted.

maxFps.description:
Highest frame rate the wallpaper needs, 1 to 240. Animated images use
their own frame timing up to this cap; shaders default to 30.

background.description: Color behind letterboxed images, `#RRGGBB`. Defaults to black.

oneOf.description: Fill the screen and crop the overflow. The default.
Stretch to the screen, ignoring the aspect ratio.

Fit.description: How an image is fitted to the screen.
